description: WHEN: to READ from the ERP through form tools, where several calls must share ONE ERP session: open a form, filter its grid, read its values. Each separate erp_read / erp_call starts a new ERP session, so a form opened by one call is gone at the next; this tool runs the steps in order in a single session. Every step must be a read-only tool (opening, filtering, selecting, reading); it refuses the whole call, before running anything, if one step could change data. It stops at the first step that fails. stepsJson: [{"tool":"form_open_menu_item","arguments":{...}}, ...], at most 15 steps. Close the forms you open as the last step.

stepsJson.description: JSON array of steps: [{"tool":"<name from erp_list_tools>","arguments":{...}}].

name: erp_read_session
